context: A mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: 電卓/めまい/日課/美徳/二次会/失恋/老婆/バルト

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、家計の計算、絶対、電卓、絶対、ママ、絶対、使ってるわよ
lines.en: Sho, I'm telling you — Mommy uses a calculator for the household budget every single time.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, almost conspiratorial. A little laugh underneath. Warm and direct, as if sharing a secret that's not really a secret.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、めまい、絶対、するんだ
lines.en: Mom, seriously — I get a little dizzy sometimes, I really do.
lines.style: Quiet and earnest, with a hint of concern. Not dramatizing, just stating fact. Soft pause before the admission.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 毎朝の体操、本気で、絶対、ママの、絶対、日課、絶対、なのよ、翔くん
lines.en: My morning exercises are part of my daily routine, Sho — I do them every single day.
lines.style: Measured and steady, with quiet conviction. Not boasting, just affirming something she believes in. Slight warmth toward Sho at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、正直さは、絶対、美徳、絶対、って、絶対、言ってたよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa used to say that honesty is a real virtue — he really believed that.
lines.style: Gentle and thoughtful, reaching back into memory. Small voice thinking aloud. Respect in the phrasing, not argument.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さんの会社の、本気で、絶対、二次会、絶対、ママも、絶対、お呼ばれしたわよ、翔くん
lines.en: Your father's company invited me to the after-party too, Sho — it was quite the event.
lines.style: A lift of pride and amusement in the delivery. Light, sharing something she's pleased about. Not boasting, just content.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お兄ちゃん、本気で、絶対、最近、絶対、失恋、絶対、したらしいよ、ママ
lines.en: Your big brother seems to have had his heart broken recently, Mom — that's what I heard.
lines.style: Careful, concerned tone. Observant — not gossiping, but noticing something that matters. Slight hesitation, like he's choosing his words.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 昔話に、本気で、絶対、優しい、絶対、老婆、絶対、出てくるわよね、翔くん
lines.en: In the old fairy tales, there's always a kind old woman who shows up, isn't there, Sho?
lines.style: Reflective and warm, like she's thinking out loud. A gentle, almost wistful quality. Inviting him to think along with her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、本気で、絶対、社会科で、絶対、バルト、絶対、三国、絶対、習ったよ、ママ
lines.en: I learned about the Baltic states in social studies class, Mom — we covered that in school.
lines.style: Eager and bright, wanting to share something he's learned. Quick pace, enthusiasm just beneath the surface. The pride of a child sharing knowledge.
